ValidationRule.description: IM-76: Parent Initiative parent should be of type Focus Area or Parent Initiative.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: !$Setup.Bypass_Automation_Setting__c.Foundation_Code_Validation__c && AND( ISPICKVAL( Type__c ,'Parent Initiative'), NOT(ISBLANK(Parent__c)), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Parent__r.Type__c ,'Focus Area')), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Parent__r.Type__c ,'Parent Initiative')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Parent Initiative Foundation code can only be associated with Focus Area or Parent Initiative Foundation Code.
